description: Before opening a link or entering credentials: detects lookalike domains (homoglyphs, mixed alphabets, typosquats), brand impersonation in domains and subdomains, hidden destinations (user@host), unsafe schemes, and risky TLDs across 70+ commonly impersonated brands. Live lookups: does the domain exist (DNS) and how old is it (registration date), since most phishing domains are days old. The page itself is never visited. Price: $0.01 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

expectedBrand.description: Optional. The brand this link claims to be, e.g. "paypal". Fails if the domain is not official.

name: link_check
title: Phishing link check
